scope.summary: Implement genital collision proxies and soft-tissue coupling for insertion scenes (spec 13.21; REQ-034): penis shaft/glans capsule chains and orifice canal colliders generated from genital channel state via the MT-541 generator, with optional BkSoftTissue cage simulation on penis base/scrotum and vulva/mons honoring erection firmness state, feeding the Cloth world for garment bulge.
acceptance_criteria: Genital colliders: penis shaft/glans capsule chain plus orifice canal colliders generated from genital channel state through the MT-541 autocollider generator, updating with length/girth/gape channel changes.

Soft-tissue coupling: penis base/scrotum and vulva/mons regions optionally cage-simulated so contact in insertion scenes squishes correctly; coupling honors firmness/engorgement state (erect is firmer per the MT-552 state machine).
Insertion scene test: a posed penetration with colliders active produces contact resolution without tunneling at documented step rates.
Proxies feed the Cloth collision world: a garment draped over an erect cock shows the correct bulge (drape smoke test).
scope.risk_if_missed: Insertion scenes without genital collision and soft-tissue coupling read as rigid intersection (REQ-034); garments over an erect penis also drape flat without the proxy feed, breaking a basic wardrobe-plus-arousal production setup.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit genital anatomy and controls

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Pure computation or schema-only behavior has no independent lifecycle event; its owning run records inputs, outputs, diagnostics, and receipts.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
This bounded in-process computation has no application or child-process watch surface.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
